title: Embeddings & Rerank Orientation Deck, Pipeline Diagrams, and Example Output Artifacts
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create an orientation deck and a set of canonical visual assets for the Embeddings + Rerank quickstart that can be used in docs, release notes, and the Console onboarding flow. Deliverables include a 6-slide orientation deck, three pipeline SVG diagrams (conceptual, technical, and edge cases), four hi-fi screen screenshots (Console), and a folder of example outputs demonstrating rerank behavior on short vs. long contexts.
acceptance_criteria: Orientation deck approved by PM and Eng lead
Three pipeline diagrams exported as accessible SVGs with text alternatives
Hi-fi Console screenshots match current Console styles and are export-ready (PNG + 2x retina)
Example outputs cover at least: short query, long-doc retrieval, and adversarial near-duplicate case
Design tokens (color, spacing, typography) documented for engineers
Accessibility checks completed (contrast ratios, screen reader labels)
ux_tasks: Draft orientation deck outline and primary learning objectives
Sketch conceptual pipeline (user-facing) and technical pipeline (dataflow, embeddings store, rerank model)
Iterate hi-fi Console screenshots with Solutions Eng for realistic dataset rows
Create sample output JSON blobs and render into annotated cards
Export all assets (SVG/PNG) and upload to Drive with README
visual_spec_notes: Visual language should be modular and reusable in docs. Use existing Console color tokens: token-primary #0066FF, token-accent #00B27A. Diagrams must show latency/cost trade-offs inline (microcopy: 'cache hit reduces per-request tokens by ~40%'). Pipeline diagrams split into three lanes: Client -> Indexing -> Retrieval+Embeddings -> Rerank -> Response. For sample outputs, annotate rerank score, similarity, and reason snippet. Avoid hero imagery; prefer simplified system diagrams and data cards.
review_feedback: PM (C. Nguyen) - prefer a short 1-slide TL;DR summary for README
Eng Lead (Mira Kwon) - add a small note about index maintenance and vector garbage collection
Solutions Eng (J. Alvarez) - suggested using an e-commerce example for sample outputs to match common customer use-cases
Accessibility (R. Chen) - ensure all SVG text is exported as accessible text elements and provide alt copy
